note: 岗位气质编号库。v1 收录 20 个高频岗位，用于工牌/门禁/企业 IM 头像。

personas.gaze: 平视镜头，目光聚焦不游移，带一点想事情的延迟感
personas.posture: 肩线正对镜头，下巴微收 3 度，双肩放松下沉
personas.prompt_zh: 低调的技术气质：深色简约上衣，无任何标识，面部不加滤镜修饰，表情平静而专注，传递可信赖的工程感
personas.prompt_en: Understated engineering presence: dark minimal top without any logo, unretouched skin, calm focused expression, conveying dependable technical credibility
personas.pitfalls: 过度磨皮和美白会直接削弱可信度；西装领带会让人误读为销售岗

personas.gaze: 直视镜头，眼神明亮，眉尾略微上扬表示兴趣
personas.posture: 上身略前倾 5 度，肩线打开
personas.prompt_zh: 清爽的协作者气质：浅色简洁上衣，明亮面部光，自然露齿轻笑，眼神有交流感，像一个随时能把你问题接住的人
personas.prompt_en: Crisp collaborator presence: light clean top, bright facial lighting, natural closed-lip-to-slight smile, engaging eye contact that reads as someone ready to own your problem
personas.pitfalls: 笑过头会变成客服；背景过暗会显得疲惫

personas.gaze: 平视，目光稳定不眨，嘴角完全闭合
personas.posture: 肩线水平端正，颈部拉长，头不偏
personas.prompt_zh: 克制的专业感：深色合体西装与素色内搭，冷白调光，面部线条干净利落，无首饰无装饰，表情中性偏严谨
personas.prompt_en: Restrained professionalism: well-fitted dark suit with plain inner layer, cool white lighting, clean facial lines, no jewelry or accessories, neutral-to-serious expression
personas.pitfalls: 背景出现城市天际线或书架会显得刻意；暖光会削弱严谨感

personas.gaze: 略低于眼位的机位，目光平直不逼迫
personas.posture: 端正坐姿感，双肩下沉，头部保持水平
personas.prompt_zh: 权威而不压迫：挺括深色正装与清晰领口，中等对比度的稳重型打光，表情沉稳、嘴角闭合，传递可托付的判断力
personas.prompt_en: Authority without intimidation: crisp dark formal wear with a clean collar line, moderate-contrast steady lighting, composed closed-mouth expression signaling sound judgment
personas.pitfalls: 机位过高会显得弱势；背景纹理过重抢注意力

personas.gaze: 正视镜头，目光温和但不停留游移
personas.posture: 肩线正对，颈部露出，白大褂领口平整
personas.prompt_zh: 洁净的临床可信度：平整白大褂配浅色内搭，高调明亮布光，头发与领口整洁，表情温和镇定，无首饰无杂物
personas.prompt_en: Clinical trust through cleanliness: crisp white coat over a light inner layer, high-key bright lighting, neat hair and collar, calm warm expression, no jewelry or clutter
personas.pitfalls: 背景出现听诊器特写或药品会像广告图；阴影过重显得病态

personas.gaze: 眼神柔和，眼角自然放松
personas.posture: 肩线略向镜头方向打开，头可微侧 5 度
personas.prompt_zh: 安心的照护感：整洁浅色制服，头发放顺束起，柔和散射光，自然真诚的微笑，眼周放松，传递耐心与可靠
personas.prompt_en: Reassuring care: neat light uniform, hair softly tied back, diffused gentle lighting, genuine natural smile with relaxed eye area, conveying patience and reliability
personas.pitfalls: 笑容僵硬会立刻掉信任；浓妆与制服气质冲突

personas.gaze: 正视镜头，目光平稳带一点审视的善意
personas.posture: 肩线水平端正，下颌略收
personas.prompt_zh: 有秩序感的亲和力：素雅衬衫或开衫，中等明度均匀布光，表情温和中带一点严肃，像能同时管好四十个人的神态
personas.prompt_en: Orderly warmth: muted shirt or cardigan, even medium-brightness lighting, an expression gently warm yet slightly serious, the look that holds a room of forty
personas.pitfalls: 背景书架虚化过度像咖啡厅；过于时髦的穿搭削弱权威

personas.gaze: 直视镜头，眉毛自然舒展，眼神先一步打招呼
personas.posture: 上身略前倾，肩打开，头保持水平
personas.prompt_zh: 主动的可信感：合体衬衫与整洁仪容，明亮通透布光，露齿轻笑、眉宇舒展，神态像已经准备好回应你的需求
personas.prompt_en: Proactive credibility: fitted shirt with neat grooming, bright transparent lighting, open slight smile with relaxed brows, radiating readiness to respond
personas.pitfalls: 笑过度和露齿过多会显轻浮；深色背景削弱主动性印象

personas.gaze: 平视镜头，目光直接不绕
personas.posture: 肩线正对，姿态放松但不塌
personas.prompt_zh: 落地能干的气质：简洁工装或 Polo 衫，自然光感不修饰，表情亲切直接、带一丝笑意，像在高峰期照样稳住场子的人
personas.prompt_en: Grounded operator vibe: simple work shirt or polo, unpolished natural light, friendly direct expression with a trace of a smile — someone who holds the floor through peak hours
personas.pitfalls: 正装感过重反而不贴岗；背景出现货架易杂乱

personas.gaze: 正视镜头，目光快而准
personas.posture: 肩线水平，头部端正不侧
personas.prompt_zh: 高压环境的利落感：深色简洁工装，稍高对比度的直白布光，表情中性而警觉，传递随时能拍板调度的稳定
personas.prompt_en: High-pressure crispness: dark spare workwear, direct lighting with slightly raised contrast, neutral alert expression that reads as ready to make the call
personas.pitfalls: 柔光会让人怀疑执行力；背景虚化过强像棚拍广告

personas.gaze: 眼神柔和正视，不刻意讨好
personas.posture: 肩线打开，头微侧不超过 5 度
personas.prompt_zh: 得体不过界的亲和：整洁制服或衬衫，均匀中明度布光，礼貌而有分寸的浅笑，眼神愿意听但不谄媚
personas.prompt_en: Measured approachability: neat uniform or shirt, even medium-brightness lighting, a polite restrained smile, willing-to-listen eyes without flattery
personas.pitfalls: 笑得太大显得不专业；过暗背景让人误判为管理层

personas.gaze: 直视镜头，眼神带一点分享好消息的劲
personas.posture: 上身端直，肩打开，微前倾
personas.prompt_zh: 热络的干练感：合体西装或挺括衬衫，明亮通透布光，露齿微笑，眼神像带着客户没开口就知道他要什么的消息
personas.prompt_en: Personable competence: fitted suit or crisp shirt with bright clear lighting, open smile, eyes carrying good news before you ask
personas.pitfalls: 背景放楼盘或钥匙易像素材模板；笑过头损专业

personas.gaze: 目光略微偏离镜头 10 度，或直视但放松
personas.posture: 肩线可略斜，姿态自然不做作
personas.prompt_zh: 松弛的审美感：纯色基础款、无任何标识，低饱和色调，表情淡然，姿态自然不摆拍，靠克制体现品位
personas.prompt_en: Relaxed taste: solid basics with no logo, desaturated tones, plain expression, unstudied posture — restraint as the signal of judgment
personas.pitfalls: 背景出现设计作品或色卡像在炫；摆拍感会破坏松弛

personas.impression_en: Agile, current, easy to work with
personas.gaze: 眼神灵动，眉尾轻微上挑
personas.posture: 肩线自然，头可微侧 8 度
personas.prompt_zh: 明快的协作感：轻时尚基础款与明快配色，自然光，真实笑容与灵动眼神，神态传递反应快、跟得住热点
personas.prompt_en: Bright collaborator energy: casual fashion basics with fresh color, natural light, genuine smile and lively eyes that signal quick, current instincts
personas.pitfalls: 过度正装显得不搭岗；色调灰暗会毁掉网感

personas.gaze: 正视镜头，目光稳定且不带评判
personas.posture: 肩线水平端正，头保持水平
personas.prompt_zh: 有原则的亲和力：中性色衬衫或外套，柔亮均匀布光，礼貌浅笑与不带评判的注视，像能说真话的人也听得进话
personas.prompt_en: Principled warmth: neutral shirt or blazer, soft even lighting, a polite smile and non-judgmental gaze — someone who speaks straight and listens back
personas.pitfalls: 笑得过甜削弱原则感；冷光会显得像审计岗

personas.gaze: 平视，目光安静聚焦
personas.posture: 肩线端平，身体不做倾斜
personas.prompt_zh: 安静的严谨感：素色衬衫配深色外套，干净无杂讯的布光，表情中性、嘴唇闭合，传递不差毫厘的耐心
personas.prompt_en: Quiet rigor: plain shirt under a dark layer, clean noise-free lighting, neutral closed-mouth expression that reads as exacting patience
personas.pitfalls: 配饰与花哨领口破坏克制感；暖黄光显得随意

personas.gaze: 直视镜头，眼神先一步回应
personas.posture: 肩线放松打开，微前倾
personas.prompt_zh: 回应感极强的气质：简洁工服或纯色上衣，明亮通透布光，轻笑且目光主动，传递不会把你的问题推回去
personas.prompt_en: Strongly responsive presence: neat uniform or plain top, bright clear lighting, a light smile with initiating eyes that promise no runaround
personas.pitfalls: 表情过冷会让客户以为要排队；背景杂乱损可信度

personas.impression_zh: 整齐划一、有品牌感、亲和
personas.gaze: 标准正视镜头，目光干净统一
personas.posture: 统一规范：肩线水平正对镜头，头不侧
personas.prompt_zh: 品牌统一规范感：整洁品牌工服与规范仪容，标准正面姿态，统一底色与光型，微笑幅度控制在标准范围，适合批量出图
personas.prompt_en: Brand-uniform standard: tidy branded uniform with grooming standards, squared-on posture, unified backdrop and lighting, smile held within standard range, built for batch output
personas.pitfalls: 个性化打光会破坏整批一致性；批量场景务必锁定同一背景与光型

personas.gaze: 正视镜头，目光朴实稳定
personas.posture: 肩线正对，姿态自然不挺胸
personas.prompt_zh: 朴实的可靠感：整洁工服与安全规范着装，自然偏硬的光，表情朴实稳定，不摆拍不修饰，传递一线实干的信任
personas.prompt_en: Plain reliability: clean work uniform with safety compliance, natural slightly hard light, grounded steady expression, unposed and unretouched — frontline trust
personas.pitfalls: 背景出现设备易失焦杂乱；过度美颜会失去岗位真实感

personas.impression_zh: 专业但不冷，有个人风格
personas.impression_en: Professional yet personal, with signature style
personas.gaze: 直视镜头，眼神有内容和故事感
personas.posture: 端正但放松，允许肩线有 5 度自然差
personas.prompt_zh: 有辨识度的专业：质感基础款与克制细节，带层次的主光与轮廓光，浅笑且眼神有内容，既专业又像有自己方法论的人
personas.prompt_en: Distinctive professionalism: textured basics with restrained detail, layered key and rim lighting, a soft smile with substance behind the eyes — expert with a point of view
personas.pitfalls: 层次光过强变明星写真；配饰抢戏会削弱专业主线
